interface.longDescription:
AuditTrove reviews user-provided PDF documents: contracts, lease agreements, insurance policies and financial reports. It turns the findings into a clear, page-referenced review with a score.

Every finding carries a quotation copied word for word from the document, the page that quotation appears on, and the position of that passage on the page. A finding that cannot be grounded in the document does not enter the report.

It supports preliminary decision-making. It does not determine lawfulness or regulatory compliance, and it does not replace professional financial, legal, or investment advice.

Documents are not stored.
defaultPrompt: Review this contract and highlight anything I should pay attention to before signing.
Analyze this lease agreement and give me a page-referenced review with a score.
Review this financial report and summarize the key findings and risks.
